description: This file defines the AutoPurgeScheduler class responsible for scheduling and executing automatic task purging operations in a VSCode extension environment. It manages periodic purge checks, manual triggers, and interacts with AutoPurgeService and TelemetryService.

classes.name: AutoPurgeScheduler
classes.description: Scheduler class for managing automatic task purging, including starting, stopping, manual triggering, and scheduling next runs.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes AutoPurgeService with the provided storage path.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the scheduler with callbacks to get settings, task history, current task ID, and optional purge callback.

methods.name: triggerManualPurge
methods.description: Manually triggers a purge operation, capturing telemetry event.

methods.name: runScheduledPurge
methods.description: Performs scheduled purge check, respecting settings and timing constraints, with error handling.

methods.name: executePurge
methods.description: Executes the purge process, updates telemetry, and shows info message if tasks are purged.

methods.name: scheduleNext
methods.description: Schedules the next purge check after the defined interval.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns current status including whether running, scheduled, and next run time.
